representative_before_after.before: Paint sticks only to bare wood; cloth removes only paint and never wood.
representative_before_after.after: Treat and remove the outer skin of the original solid; explicitly distinguish substrate removal from adding/removing a coating.

representative_before_after.before: A low-k dielectric reduces unwanted capacitive coupling compared with a more strongly polarizable material.
representative_before_after.after: At the gate we want strong coupling to control the channel; between wires we want weak coupling to reduce neighbor disturbance and required charge. Define low-k after the contrasting jobs.

limits: Selected passages rather than all approximately 4,350 source lines were edited. Deep recipes, market claims and numerical assumptions retain prior evidence limits.
Targeted nearby figures and quiz explanations were source-reviewed for contradiction, not rerendered in this language subtask.

Module13 opening still contains broad claims about optical invisibility of a 20 nm defect and yield fixed before design; these deserve separate precision/fact review and were not expanded into new claims here.
